patthana22.6:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi,
patthana22.6:2.1: na kusalaṃ na no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā nava.
patthana22.6:3.1: na kusalaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā pañca,
patthana22.6:5.1: na kusalaṃ na āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.6:6.1: na kusalaṃ na āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. nava na kusalaṃ na āsavaṃ ceva
patthana22.6:7.1: na anāsavaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavo ceva sāsavo ca dhammā uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi,
patthana22.6:8.1: na kusalaṃ na anāsavañceva na no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā nava, na kusalaṃ na āsavañceva na
patthana22.6:9.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi,
patthana22.6:10.1: na kusalaṃ na āsavavippayuttañceva na no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi,
patthana22.6:11.1: na kusalaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato āsavavippayutto sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā pañca. na kusalaṃ no saññojanaṃ
